title: Add Android game brightness control
changes: Add a persistent 50%–150% game brightness control to Video & zoom, applied to the world and independent game UI panels.
Document the Android menu differences from desktop.
validation: ARM64 Docker APK build and Kotlin unit tests passed in android-menu-brightness-retry-bo68b3mn.
Mesa EGL compiled and linked both GLES2 shaders; world pixel output passed at 50%, 100% and 150% in android-menu-render-i55j9x69.
limitations: Physical Android device rendering and input were not tested; the remaining desktop menu features are not ported.
